title: Express static server
intent: The canonical Node HTTP server, and the shape our http shim must support first: createServer, listen, serve bytes, return 200.
source: stackblitz-conformance: NodeJS http server, via the most common framework (public 'Runtime Test Cases for AI Agents' suite, adapted into our own scenario)

steps.purpose: Start the server on a fixed port

knownLimits: Bodies must survive as bytes. A string-only transport corrupts binary responses, which is why the response contract is typed rather than incidental.
